training.supervised_target: known generating burst probability for independent detector-only calibration batches

cnn.architecture: 3D convolution over Stim-derived (time=6,y=4,x=4) grid; channels=marginal rate, burst-pair cofire rate, occupancy mask
cnn.selection: minimum held-out validation MAE; earlier epoch wins ties

ridge.feature_definition: 45 Stage 4B detector-only marginal and pair-cofire means
ridge.selection: minimum validation MAE; smaller alpha wins ties

training_partition_policy: One Stim detector-only array per unique seed; shared by all estimators. Known generation p is a supervised target for training and validation only.
paired_evaluation_policy: Every decoder arm uses identical saved evaluation detector rows and observable row order; observable labels are only passed to scoring after predictions exist.

statistical_plan.primary_estimand: Equal-weight mean across nonzero p={0.004,0.008,0.012,0.016} of root-mean paired LER difference CNN-estimator PyMatching minus Stage4B-profile-estimator PyMatching.

bootstrap.method: stratified independent-root bootstrap, resample 7 roots with replacement within each p stratum

primary_test.method: two-sided Monte Carlo paired root sign-flip; independently flip signs within each nonzero p stratum

statistical_plan.secondary_family: Three equal-weight root-stratified sign-flip tests: CNN minus fixed nominal, CNN minus Ridge-assisted, Ridge-assisted minus Stage4B profile; Holm correction across these three. Condition-specific effects are descriptive.
statistical_plan.zero_burst_safety: one-sided 95% stratified root-bootstrap upper bound for CNN minus Stage4B profile at p=0

cnn_keep_requires_all: at least 3 of 4 nonzero condition means favor CNN
CNN is not materially worse than Ridge in validation estimation MAE (<=0.0005 absolute p)
decision_rule.otherwise: DROP if evidence shows no advantage or is unfavorable; INCONCLUSIVE if uncertainty prevents a reliable keep/drop distinction. Prefer the simpler Stage4B profile estimator absent a demonstrated CNN advantage.

claims_boundary: Development-only synthetic-noise feasibility result; no hardware validation or independent confirmation.
